blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Customs (BOC) on Wednesday said Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno remains the head of the agency amid rumors of possible leadership changes. “The BOC has not received any official directive from Malacañang regarding any change in its leadership,” it said in a statement. “As such, Commissioner Ariel F. Nepomuceno continues to lead the BOC and remains fully focused on advancing its mandate of strengthening border protection, facilitating legitimate trade, implementing meaningful reforms, and ensuring the collection of revenues that support government programs and services,” it added.
